name: Vehicle safety complaints by state, make and model year (NHTSA complaint file)
description: Safety complaints about cars, trucks, SUVs, motorcycles and RVs that owners filed with the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), counted from its Office of Defects Investigation complaint file for the ten most recent model years, by the complainant's state, the make, the model year and the part of the vehicle named (engine, brakes, air bags, steering and the other NHTSA component groups). Each record gives the complaints, how many report a crash, a fire, an injury or a death, the people reported injured and killed, the complaints filed in the last twelve months, and how many concern a make, model and year that has a safety recall (and a recall of the same system), joined from NHTSA's recall file. State records list every make; make records add the model year by component table and each model's counts; national make records add each model by model year and the number of recall campaigns. A complaint is counted once however many parts it names. Only counts are kept: no narrative, VIN, city, name or complaint number.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Vehicle safety complaints by state, make and model year (NHTSA complaint file) (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23964283
keywords: car defect complaints by make and model year

distribution.name: vehicle-complaints.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: vehicle-complaints.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: vehicle-complaints-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in vehicle-complaints-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to vehicle-complaints.csv on id.

recordSet.name: vehicle-complaints
recordSet.description: The records of Vehicle safety complaints by state, make and model year (NHTSA complaint file), one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter code of the complainant's state or territory, or US (national records and complaints with no U.S. state)

field.name: level
field.description: us, state, state-not-given (complaints with a military mail code, an address outside the states and territories, or no state on the complaint), make (one make in one state) or us-make (one make nationally)

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: Complaints (same as complaints)

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of value

field.name: complaints
field.description: Vehicle safety complaints about the model years in the window, counted once per ODI number however many components they name

field.name: crash
field.description: Complaints that report a crash

field.name: fire
field.description: Complaints that report a fire

field.name: injury
field.description: Complaints that report at least one person injured

field.name: death
field.description: Complaints that report at least one death

field.name: injured
field.description: People reported injured in those complaints (a value of 99, the field's maximum, is treated as unknown and left out)

field.name: died
field.description: People reported killed in those complaints (99 treated as unknown, as for injured)

field.name: recalled
field.description: Complaints about a make, model and model year that has at least one NHTSA vehicle recall campaign

field.name: recalled_component
field.description: Complaints about a make, model and model year with a recall campaign for one of the component groups the complaint names

field.name: last_12m
field.description: Complaints NHTSA received in the twelve months before the file date

field.name: modelYearsFrom
field.description: First model year in the window

field.name: modelYearsTo
field.description: Last model year in the window (next year's models, on sale from the autumn)

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
